# @ndigo/management

Ndigo management endpoints — /health and /metrics (actuator-style)

Version-matched export index for the installed package. Read `README.md`
for usage; the workspace guide index ships with `@ndigo/cli` as
`assets/agent/docs-index.md`.

## Public exports

- `HealthRegistry` — Collects HealthIndicator results into a single aggregate status.
- `HealthRegistryOptions` *(type)* — Options for HealthRegistry.
- `HealthState` *(type)* — The overall health of a subsystem.
- `HealthResult` *(type)* — The health result of a single indicator.
- `HealthIndicator` *(type)* — A component that reports the health of one subsystem.
- `HealthStatus` *(type)* — The aggregated health status served by `/health`.
- `METRIC_AGGREGATOR` — Context token for the shared FeatureMetricAggregator entry that management endpoints read. Apps wire one (e.g. via `ManagementAutoConfiguration`) so `/metrics`…
- `HEALTH_REGISTRY` — Context token for the shared HealthRegistry that the `/health` endpoint reads. `ManagementAutoConfiguration` registers one and populates it with indicator wiri…
- `TelemetryHealthIndicator` — A HealthIndicator reporting the health of the telemetry/metrics pipeline.
- `ManagementAutoConfiguration`
- `ManagementAutoConfigurationOptions` *(type)* — Options for ManagementAutoConfiguration.
- `ManagementProperties` *(type)* — The validated `management.*` settings (see managementSchema).
